alt: A colorful, hand-painted ceramic artwork features vibrant yellow, red, and blue abstract patterns with black bead accents, complemented by sculpted green succulents and small stones at the base.
A close-up of a sculpted cactus arrangement featuring a twisted, dark green central column and flat paddle-like segments, adorned with bright yellow and pale pink flowers and sharp spines.
A three-tiered cake decorated with vibrant yellow and red patterns, black bead accents, and topped with realistic-looking cacti and succulents.
A two-tiered cake decorated with vibrant red and yellow patterns, black bead accents, and topped with realistic fondant cacti and flowers.

A close-up view of a highly detailed cake decorated to resemble a desert scene, featuring realistic-looking cacti with yellow flowers, green succulents, and small pebbles, all set within a colorful, patterned base.

A close-up view of a vibrant, multi-tiered cake decorated with an underwater theme, featuring a red fondant base adorned with blue and yellow piped coral, black candy pearls, and a sandy top layer scattered with small pebbles.

An elaborately decorated cake features a vibrant yellow base adorned with intricate red and blue icing patterns and black beads, topped with realistic-looking fondant cacti, succulents, and desert flowers.
